## Add a tool: <name>

- File: `tools/<slug>.yaml` (the id with `-` instead of `_`)
- Official page: <https://…>
- Why it belongs here (one sentence, what job it does):

**Checklist**
- [ ] Not already in `tools/` (searched name, aliases and URL)
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] Pricing copied as the maker states it, or `"Unknown"`; unknown facts are `null`
- [ ] No personal data, no affiliate or shortened links
- [ ] Signed off (`git commit -s`) — DCO 1.1, CC BY 4.0

Merging does not list the tool on WonderStack by itself: it arrives as a candidate an editor reviews.
